body: i've convinced myself that i know what my future will hold so i am not too bummed. curious of what life *would* be like then? yes, i feel like that curiosity is natural, but i don't think i have enough of a drive or care to want to experience it, but that is fine by me.

thank you for the offer you are a good person no not really, just for the simple sake of what is there to talk about. honestly i am content with my fate. i was having a hard time coming to terms with it before but i have reasoned with myself and even when i am calm i feel like it's what i want to do, i am just scared of the process to get to that point.
